name: swarm-wallet-core
description: The SWARM wallet as one package: the Rust/neon addon plus a typed, promise-based TypeScript API, for embedding in the SWARM Messenger apps. Keys never leave the device.

scripts.neon: cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib swarm-wallet-core-native native.node -- cargo build --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.neon-mac-x64: cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib swarm-wallet-core-native native.node -- cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.neon-mac-arm64: cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib swarm-wallet-core-native native.node -- cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.neon-win-x64: cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib swarm-wallet-core-native native.node -- cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
